q.q: Function overloading is an example of which kind of polymorphism?
q.x: Function overloading is resolved at compile time (compile-time polymorphism). Virtual functions give run-time polymorphism.

q.q: By default, members of a C++ class declared without an access specifier are:
q.x: C++ class members default to private (unlike struct members, which default to public).

q.q: Which OOP feature allows a new class to reuse and extend the members of an existing class?
q.x: Inheritance lets a derived class acquire the attributes and methods of a base class.
